text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Different souls have different aspirations 
and paths to reach them. 
Walking the path that best suits your 
nature is paramount...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(...What Rice can do in her own way. 
Even if it isn't flashy and sparkling 
like Marvelous-san's...)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(If I could just warm everyone's hearts... 
even a little bit, and bring them some 
small happiness... 
But... what should I do?)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, those flowers... 
they made a wonderful bouquet, didn't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes—their harmony with the others is 
exquisite. 
Thank you for sharing them with me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(Wow... Such pretty flowers... 
Just looking at them makes my heart feel 
all warm—!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Rice-san. 
Did you need something from us, by chance?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! S-Sorry for staring...! 
...I just thought... they're such lovely 
flowers...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whenever Rice is tired, or feeling down... 
the blue rose in the picture book 
always gives her strength...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Flowers... 
they bring warmth, enrichment, 
and peace to one's heart, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, they do... 
...They make you feel ready to try again—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. 
If Rice could bring that kind of warmth... 
to everyone else too...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—I see. 
You were searching for a way 
to cultivate harmonious happiness... were 
you not, Rice-san?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... Eye-san. 
Where did you get those flowers?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I got permission to pick them while 
training 
in the mountains with Taiho-san and the 
others. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Those mountains are full of danger. 
—Are you prepared for that?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eeeek?! T-Taiho-san?!

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Harsh mountain trails, wild beasts— 
are you truly prepared to face such 
perils?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Rice is a scaredy-cat, so... 
I can't say for sure... that I am... 
but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
E-Even if I'm scared... I don't want to 
run away...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
So Rice-senpai will be accompanying us 
this time. 
It is an honor to have you join us.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Do not push yourself too hard. 
We will fend off any threats, and should 
you tire, 
you may lean on our shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much... 
But Rice has to overcome this on her 
own... 
...Rice wants to overcome it.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
—These tracks are fresh. 
Five wild dogs. The scratches on that tree 
over there 
look like boar tusks... Large ones at 
that.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Rice-san, the footing right there is 
unstable, 
so please be careful.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...! 
Eek, whoa...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone is so amazing. 
...Rice is the only one stumbling over and 
over, 
struggling just to keep up...)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...B-But...! 
I'll keep up, I will...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to bring happiness to 
everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, what do you think? 
...This is the scenery that Rice-senpai 
reached through her very own strength.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, ahh...! 
It's just like... a picture book...

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times you fell, you 
didn't give up and kept walking. 
You are... truly strong.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wawa... Strong? Not at all. 
Rice was just... completely lost in the 
moment.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...No, you are strong. 
It was presumptuous of me to think I 
needed to protect you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us pick some flowers and head 
back! 
For the sake of everyone you wish to make 
smile.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!

At the school gate, I spotted Rice Shower 
returning from outside with an unusual 
group of companions.
choice_data_list: You're all covered in dirt, are you okay?

You look like you really accomplished 
something today.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Being this dirty just means... 
Rice was able to... work that much harder.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ehem. 
J-Just kidding...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, maybe so. 
Because I was able to do it with my own 
power.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
For everyone's sake... 
I'll definitely see this through to the 
very end...!
